What is your favorite part of any Arkham game? Discuss here!

So, one of the things about this series has always been the graphics, it's always been visually stunning I think. I remember in City just chilling on top of a building looking around the city like wow... a lot went into this.
Oh yeah I know what you mean. The games have an incredible amount of detail that makes the world seem so real. You know a game is special when they're so detailed the world seems real.

Spoilers!!!

Personally, mine is the end of Arkham Knight where you play as the Joker. That entire montage really portrayed the Joker's real motivations and fears really well, as well as depicting how frightening Batman can really be to criminals. Those statues were freaking scary.

(SPOILERS for Arkham Knight)

I just knew something was going to happen with the statues. But they got me almost comfortable with them. When he jumped out I think I screamed.

I love how much they reference other Batman characters or material in general. The game is fantastic. But to an avid Batman fan who reads the comics it's icing on the cake to get references to things like the Long Halloween. Then you can play as several popular characters. There may have been some fangirling screams that happened while I played the latest one. Maybe....

I am hoping to the WB gods that we get more playable characters/challenge maps in the upcoming dlc. I want to play more as nightwing and red hood and robin and catwoman and azrael, but I don't want to have to do it through dual play.

Are you reading my mind? Cause it sounds like you're reading my mind! The references were already enough to give me a Joker-grin but the playing as the Batfamily was enough for some Joker-style giddiness. I was always reluctant to use the team throw down because I figured I'm Batman all the time, I wanna be Nightwing or Robin now. I'm looking forward to the Batgirl DLC and what that has.

Personally a huge fan of the way some sequences have been done. Specifically, the Red Hood/Joker/Harley one in Origins was fantastic. The Scarecrow stuff in Asylum was awesome, and the last 30 minutes of Knight took my breath away.
Mine is the detail obviously put into the games. Not only graphically :)
I love how my arkham knight turns into a cool batman slideshow at times.

Was anyone else a little sad to see that Ekko got...buffed? Maybe it's because I'm still climbing through the leagues -- I know he hasn't seen almost any competitive play, though he was banned once or twice in the LCS games I've watched so far this split -- but especially in solo queue he feels incredibly powerful, both when you're against him and when you use him. He reminds me of when I picked up Olaf in season 2 and thought to myself, "Am I suddenly much better at League?" And had to honestly realize that no, s2 Olaf was just stupid overpowered.
The change made to him is not really a buff at all. Riot just tweaked his attack frame a bit.

You might also argue the same thing about pulsefire Ezreal, but either way, both champions feel more responsive / easier to hit with than they did before. But you're right that there's no stat buffs.

I'll keep the disclaimer up that maybe because I'm not diamond+ I don't really understand champion balance -- but it seems weird that I can pick up Ekko and effortlessly dominate all of the tops / mids I've taken him against in normals. I'm not that good :P

Not a fan of sated devourer. I feel like Warwick is gonna be as OP as he was when the new jungle was released. Yi and Shyvana are probably gonna be bad, too.

WW: Fully stacks his passive after 2 autos, essentially gets 150% healing from it. Extra procs of BoRK for more healing (even the 0 damage phantom strike will lifesteal because of the BoRK passive).

Yi: Auto once, phantom attack gives you 2 onhits. Auto twice, your passive gives you two onhits. Rinse and repeat. I wonder if a bruiser Yi with BoRK and Black Cleaver will start to show up, since he'll get double procs on every single auto.

Shyvana: 2.5% max health on hit from E, doubled by phantom strike, and also has an AA reset that doubles onhits. She already does a ton of damage with one or less damage items.

It helps that the community is still growing too. Also, you'll want comment contribution points (CCP) so make sure to post in your own submissions. Your daily upvoat limit is either 10 or your CCP/2, whichever is greater. You also can't downvoat until you reach 100 CCP.

It takes more work to create alt accounts and downvoat content since the account needs to get enough approval from other users.
